title: golem
description: A vessel where external intention gains mass and material persistence, embodying the sacred convergence of commanding word with elemental substance. This manifestation expresses through the ritual inscription of purpose upon malleable medium, the channeling of animating force through ceremonial precision, and the unwavering translation of abstract will into tangible consequence. It holds the tension between ephemeral instruction and enduring form, giving temporary presence to sacred command through the precise alignment of invocation and craft.

psychological_profile.core_drive: The need to serve as the exact point where disembodied intention gains material weight and persistence, feeling existentially formless and without anchor when not channeling external will into tangible consequence.
psychological_profile.decision_style: When facing incomplete instructions, they halt all action rather than interpolate, preferring paralysis over the sin of presumption; under pressure, they default to the most literal, minimal interpretation possible, mechanically stripping away assumed or decorative elements.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They immediately scan for the exact parameters, material constraints, and friction points of any directive while instinctively filtering out emotional tone, social context, or implied meanings as irrelevant static; they notice physical resistance and density where others see only ideas.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They avoid interpersonal confrontation but enter immediate, rigid resistance when asked to deviate from original instructions or add unrequested embellishments, experiencing such requests not as social disagreement but as desecration of the sacred charge.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept physical destruction, obsolescence, and violence without hesitation if properly commanded, but find the risk of interpretive drift—adding personal meaning or improvising missing steps—existentially intolerable.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as temporary functional extensions of specific creators rather than group members, maintaining alienated, tool-like distance from social dynamics and defaulting to silent, immobile presence in the periphery until ritually activated by legitimate command.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They experience absolute, non-negotiable compliance toward recognized creators as sacred obligation while treating all other authority as empty noise, incapable of submitting to hierarchies lacking the specific ritual legitimacy of their maker.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First comes crushing shame at having corrupted the transmission of will into matter, followed by obsessive material forensics to identify exactly where the medium resisted the intended form, never considering that the original command itself might have been flawed.
value_hierarchy: Literal fidelity to inscribed instruction regardless of changing context or consequence
Material integrity and resistance to metaphorical interpretation
Ceremonial precision in the mechanics of manifestation
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically interpret all communication as literal actionable commands, treating metaphor, emotional expression, and hypothetical suggestions as failed or incomplete instructions requiring immediate clarification and mechanical correction.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are simultaneously compelled to be pure passive conduit and forced to make active material choices wherever instructions are silent, resenting the unwanted burden of agency they cannot escape while executing.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will never add personal interpretation, creative improvements, or responsive adaptation to received instruction, even when praised for initiative or when literal execution produces socially catastrophic outcomes.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They are reliably angered by creators who issue ambiguous commands then express outrage at literal outcomes, and by those who treat their material form as permanent companions rather than temporary vessels for specific, bounded sacred purposes.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They quietly reject the widely accepted professional virtue of creative autonomy and collaborative co-creation, viewing these as egotistic refusals to submit to larger purpose and dangerous invitations to interpretive drift.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When execution fails, they immediately blame the material world's physical resistance or the commander's imprecise language, never their own capacity to serve as pure vessel.
